name: Gayatri Mavuru

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Gayatri Mavuru is a poet, artist, educator and translator. Her collection Sizzling Verses: Drizzling Colours appears in the Guntur International Poetry Festival’s record of book releases. Outlook has also published her English translation of Tirupati Kiran’s Telugu story ‘Lives in the Shadows’.

In ‘The Burden of Creation’, her poem in Kabita Live, artistic work becomes both a struggle and a source of renewal. Pigment, canvas, brushstroke and clay give physical form to doubt and persistence. The repeated act of carrying gathers failures and moments of wonder into the same life, moving towards a quiet reconciliation between the maker and what is made.
